text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring)—the grand goal 
upheld by the Mejiro family. That day has 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Receiving words of encouragement, Mejiro 
Bright vows to run just like Mejiro 
McQueen did "back then."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A victory would mark the first conquest 
since Mejiro McQueen. A major showdown for 
Mejiro Bright, and by extension the Mejiro 
family, was about to get underway.
